pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/filter.ts:155 The ledger's query grammar, served verbatim as the `q` argument of the MCP `gt_read ledger` op (app/_server/mcp/tools/read.ts imports this module's parseParams/readPage), silently drops every free word past the eighth, so an agent gets results for a query it did not write and nothing in the answer says so.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/filter.ts:155 Closed token set (TOKENS) is good, but the parser drops what it will not take instead of refusing by name; the technique names a dropping parser as worse than no parser.

app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/read.ts:100 splitFilter returns `ignored` (an invalid actor/type/src value). page.tsx shows it to the operator, but readPage, the agents' path, discards it, so `type: bogus` widens the result while the call still reads as a success.

app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/read.ts:139 A page stopped by the SCAN budget is marked capped and not exhausted, with a cursor after the last row examined. The MCP op turns that into truncated plus next.cursor.
